The document contains specifications for nitrogen pressure gauges in the TES area.
There are two types of pressure gauges: Bourdon tube and Bourdon tube with differential pressure capability.
The gauges have a range from 0 to 20 psi-g for some instruments and 0 to 10 psi-g for others.
All pressure gauges must be calibrated by the vendor, and a certificate of calibration is required.
The gauge fill fluid varies between glycerine and high-temperature silicone.
